title: gouldia axillaris var. nodosa
intro: Gouldia axillaris var. nodosa, commonly known as the Nodose Gouldia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Myrtaceae. It is native to Australia and is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits.
